title: Verbal Prefixes 5: раз- / разо- (apart, completely, intensify)
titleRussian: Глагольные приставки 5: раз- / разо- (врозь, полностью, усилить)
description: The prefix раз- carries three shades: pulling apart (разделить, разорвать), completing fully (разбить, разогреть), and intensifying a process (разговориться, рассмеяться). The variant разо- appears before consonant clusters (разо- + й-: разошёлся).
descriptionRussian: Приставка раз- даёт три оттенка: разделение на части (разделить, разорвать), полное завершение (разбить, разогреть) и усиление процесса (разговориться, рассмеяться). Вариант разо- появляется перед стечением согласных (разо- + й-: разошёлся).
intro: Apart, completely, or a process getting going after a slow start. This prefix also changes its own shape depending on what follows: it loses a letter before some consonants and gains one before clusters. That happens automatically for pronunciation, so it is something to recognize when reading rather than a decision to make.
rules: Shade 1 (apart): раз- on object verbs means 'into parts.' Разделить, разрезать, разорвать, разойтись. Often paired with 'на + acc' to name the parts.
Shade 2 (completely): раз- on action verbs means 'to full completion / destruction.' Разбить, разогреть, разрушить, разозлить.
Shade 3 (intensify a process): раз- plus a reflexive verb means 'the process takes off after a slow start.' Разговориться, рассмеяться, разозлиться, разболеться.
The shape changes automatically: рас- before a voiceless consonant (рассмеяться), разо- before a consonant cluster (разойтись, разогреть). Same prefix, same meaning.
Many раз- perfectives pair with derived impf forms in -ивать / -ывать (разогреть / разогревать, разозлить / разозлять).
examples: Маша разделила пирог на четыре части. (Masha divided the cake into four pieces.) Shade 1: apart, with 'на + acc' phrase.
Антон разбил чашку, когда мыл посуду. (Anton broke the cup while washing dishes.) Shade 2: completely, single event.
Маша разогрела суп на плите перед обедом. (Masha heated the soup on the stove before lunch.) Shade 2: heated fully.
Гости разошлись после полуночи. (The guests dispersed after midnight.) Shade 1: apart, in different directions.
Маша разговорилась с соседкой и просидела у неё час. (Masha got into a long conversation with her neighbour.) Shade 3: process intensifies.
Антон рассмеялся над шуткой. (Anton burst out laughing at the joke.) Shade 3: рас- spelling before с-.

tables.title: Three shades of раз- with example verbs

rows.label: Apart (into parts)
cells: на + acc phrase naming the parts

rows.label: Completely (full extent)
cells: single event with full destruction or completion

rows.label: Intensify a process
cells: reflexive ending -ся; process picks up after slow start

rows.label: рас-
cells: before voiceless consonants (с, т, к, ш, ч, п, ф, х)

rows.label: разо-
cells: before consonant clusters at the start of the root

items.prompt: Я _____ весь чай за завтраком. (warm-up from Lesson 4)
items.promptEnglish: I (m) drank all the tea at breakfast.
items.hint: Recap from Lesson 4: 'весь' cue + consume up. Which prefix?
items.explanation: Recap from Lesson 4: 'весь чай' signals the consume-completely shade 2 of вы- → выпил. Today's lesson moves to раз- and its three shades: apart, completely, intensify.

items.promptEnglish: Masha divided the cake into four pieces.
items.hint: 'На четыре части' = into pieces. Shade 1: which prefix?
items.explanation: 'На + acc' naming the pieces signals shade 1 of раз-: separation into parts. Past fem pf разделить → разделила. Делила is the ongoing process; поделила is a closely related verb meaning 'shared out' (also valid in everyday speech but less specifically division-into-parts); переделала would mean 'redid.'

items.promptEnglish: Anton broke the cup while washing dishes.
items.hint: 'Broke' = smashed to pieces. Shade 2: which prefix?
items.explanation: 'Broke a cup' is the canonical раз- shade 2: bring to full completion / destruction. Past masc pf of разбить → разбил. Бил is the impf process (was hitting); побил means 'beat up'; выбил means 'knocked out / dislodged.'

items.hint: They went in different directions. Which prefix marks 'apart'?
items.explanation: 'After midnight' implies the guests left and went separately home. Shade 1 with a motion verb: разо- (the variant before й-) plus идти gives разойтись. Past pl pf разошлись. Шли is the ongoing process; пошли is a single onset of motion in one direction; вышли is exit from one specific space.

items.prompt: Маша _____ с соседкой о новостях и просидела у неё час.
items.promptEnglish: Masha got into a long conversation with her neighbour about the news and sat there for an hour.
items.hint: Process intensifies: a long conversation after small talk. Which reflexive раз- verb?
items.explanation: 'Sat there for an hour' signals the process intensification of shade 3: разговориться (reflexive). Past fem gives разговорилась. Поговорила would be a brief conversation; сказала is one-time saying; договорилась means 'agreed on something.'

items.prompt: Антон _____ над шуткой и долго не мог остановиться.
items.promptEnglish: Anton burst out laughing at the joke and couldn't stop for a long time.
items.hint: 'Burst out laughing' + 'couldn't stop' = process intensifies. Which prefix? (Watch the spelling.)
items.explanation: Shade 3 with the рас- spelling (before voiceless с): рас- plus смеяться gives рассмеяться. Past masc рассмеялся. Смеялся is the impf ongoing laughter; посмеялся means 'laughed for a while' (briefer); разозлился means 'got angry' (shade 3 too, but wrong meaning).

blanks: Маша _____ суп на плите перед обедом. (Masha heated the soup on the stove before lunch.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: 'Heating soup fully on the stove' signals shade 2 of раз- (in the разо- variant before a consonant cluster): разо- plus греть gives разогреть, past fem разогрела. Греть is the impf ongoing heating; согрела means 'warmed up (oneself or a person)' rather than reheating food; погрела is 'warmed for a while' (briefer).

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Masha divided the cake into six pieces.
minimalPairs.explanation: 'На шесть кусков' (into six pieces) signals the prototypical separation shade: разделить gives разделила. Поделила exists ('shared out') and would work in some contexts but is less precise for 'divide into N pieces.' The раз- shade 1 is the standard form.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Anton burst out laughing at a good joke.
minimalPairs.explanation: 'Burst out laughing' marks the process intensification: рас- plus смеяться gives рассмеялся (shade 3). Посмеялся means 'laughed for a while / had a chuckle,' a briefer and less abrupt event. The раз- (рас-) shade marks the bursting-out moment.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: The little girl burst into tears from hurt feelings.
errorCorrection.explanation: Before a voiceless consonant (here п), раз- is spelled рас-: расплакалась. Разплакалась keeps the voiced -з- before voiceless п-, which the spelling rule forbids. Заплакала (за-) marks a plain onset without the burst-out intensity of рас-.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: The mechanic took the engine apart in an hour.
errorCorrection.explanation: Before the consonant cluster бр- at the start of the root, раз- inserts an -о-: разо- + брал gives разобрал. The form without the inserted vowel (разбрал) is unpronounceable and not Russian. Розобрал misspells the prefix vowel.

errorCorrection.sentence: Маша раскладывала покупки по полкам и пошла отдыхать.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Masha put the shopping away on the shelves and went to rest.
errorCorrection.explanation: The sequential 'и пошла отдыхать' (a single completed event before the rest) requires a perfective: разложила. The imperfective раскладывала describes an ongoing process, which cannot precede the 'and then' continuation as a finished step.

errorCorrection.sentence: Дедушка рассказать интересную историю вчера вечером.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Grandpa told an interesting story yesterday evening.
errorCorrection.explanation: A past-tense narrative needs a conjugated past-tense verb, not the infinitive: рассказал (past masc). Рассказать is the dictionary infinitive; in a sentence it must take tense and gender. Рассказала is feminine and расскажет is future.

errorCorrection.sentence: Щенок случайно зарвал газету на кусочки.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: The puppy accidentally tore the newspaper to pieces.
errorCorrection.explanation: Tearing something to pieces is the раз- shade of full destruction: разорвал ('на кусочки' is the cue). Зарвал is not a Russian word. Оторвал means 'tore off (one piece)' and надорвал 'tore slightly', both weaker than shredding.

errorCorrection.sentence: Антон встретил старого друга, и они поговорили на целых два часа.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Anton met an old friend, and they got talking for a whole two hours.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'На целых два часа' (for a whole two hours) signals a conversation that took off and ran long, the раз- shade 3 (intensify a process): разговорились (reflexive). Поговорили means 'had a brief chat,' which 'целых два часа' contradicts. Договорились means 'reached an agreement'; наговорили means 'said a lot.' The раз- plus reflexive marks the process picking up after a slow start.

errorCorrection.sentence: Антон порезал лист бумаги на узкие полоски для поделки.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Anton cut the sheet of paper into narrow strips for a craft.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'На узкие полоски' (into narrow strips) signals separation into parts, the раз- shade 1: разрезал. Порезал means 'cut up / nick' without the into-pieces precision (and can mean 'cut oneself'). Вырезал means 'cut out' (a shape from the middle); отрезал means 'cut off' (a piece from the edge). The раз- prefix plus 'на + acc' is the standard 'cut into several pieces.'

reviewVocab.definition: the prefix раз- (turns the verb perfective and adds one of three shades: apart, completely, or intensify; spelling varies as раз- / разо- / рас- depending on the following sound)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Маша разделила пирог на четыре части' приставка раз- работает в шкале «врозь / на части».

reviewVocab.definition: division into parts (the apart shade of раз-; the verb is paired with 'на + acc' to name the parts)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Антон разрезал бумагу на полоски' приставка раз- даёт смысл разделения на части.

reviewVocab.definition: intensification of a process (the third shade of раз-; the verb is reflexive and marks the moment when a process takes off after a slow start)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Маша разговорилась с соседкой' приставка раз- маркирует усиление процесса разговора.
